summary: Tested the fix for intentionally emptied letter template sections (recipient/greeting/subject). Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass. Checked: section-defaults returns '' for emptied sections; PDF and DOCX with emptied sections contain no 'إلى:', 'السلام عليكم' or 'الموضوع:' while the body and closing still render; the template_id-only issue path (no sections sent) also hides them; letters with no template and no sections still render 'إلى: name / title', the greeting and 'الموضوع: ...' as before (no regression); PUT of a template keeps '' values. Frontend: logged in as admin via the UI with no problems. In the template modal, lt-sections shows only the recipient, greeting and subject editors (no closing or signature). Ctrl+A then Delete in the recipient editor leaves it empty after blur and after save. The saved template has sections={recipient:''}. Reopening with letter-template-edit-{id} shows the recipient still empty. Issue tab: picking the template loads an empty recipient, and the live preview has no 'إلى:' line. Editing the greeting updates the live preview. '⭐ كقالب' (letter-save-template-btn) saved a template with recipient '', the custom greeting and the subject, without closing or signature.

minor.issue: When recipient or greeting is emptied, the layout gap after it (gap_recipient, and gap_greeting adjustments) is still applied, so a blank band stays at the top of the letter. Cosmetic only; for a free-text or agreement template the body starts lower than you might expect.

ui_bugs.issue: An emptied section editor shows the placeholder 'اكتب متن الإفادة هنا…' (statement-body text), which is misleading for recipient, greeting or subject. Suggest passing a placeholder such as 'فارغ — لن يظهر هذا الجزء في الخطاب'.

action_items: Optional: skip the gap_recipient spacing in PDF and DOCX when the recipient was emptied on purpose ('recipient' in raw_secs but not in secs), and do the same for the greeting.
Optional: pass a section-specific placeholder to SecBlock's StatementBodyEditor so an emptied part reads as 'this part is hidden'.
critical_code_review_comments:
The v is not None checks in _effective_sections, _compose and finalize_draft are correct. The editor emits '' when empty, and the PDF/DOCX code treats '' and '

' as deliberately emptied.

Behavior change: any non-HTML plain-text section value is now hidden instead of falling back to the old default. A database check found 0 non-HTML and 0 empty section values across 121 letters, 42 templates and 1 letterhead, so existing data is not affected.
Frontend tplSecDefaults is fetched without template_id, which is correct because tform.sections overrides it in tplSections.
